maddeler.e:
احتفرت (form VIII)
# اِحْتَفَرْتُ (iḥtafartu) /iħ.ta.far.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# اِحْتَفَرْتَ (iḥtafarta) /iħ.ta.far.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# اِحْتَفَرْتِ (iḥtafarti) /iħ.ta.far.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# اِحْتَفَرَتْ (iḥtafarat) /iħ.ta.fa.rat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
